name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_quality_outlier_audit_20260802_224653_427195
sql:
/* 繁体 D3 高等级伙伴/技能账号审计：核对当前 AccountMap 及所有已知 user_id 的黑名单标签。 */
WITH AccountUsers AS (
 SELECT "#account_id" aid,"#user_id" uid
 FROM ta.v_event_18
 WHERE "$part_event" IN ('login','new_role') AND "#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1,2
),
AccountMap AS (SELECT aid,MAX(uid) uid FROM AccountUsers GROUP BY 1),
Blacklist AS (
 SELECT "#user_id" uid,ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT cluster_name),',') tags
 FROM user_result_cluster_18
 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water') GROUP BY 1
),
Items AS (
 SELECT v.lid aid,v."#event_time" et,'伙伴' system,TRY_CAST(t.pet_id AS BIGINT) item_id,TRY_CAST(t.level AS BIGINT) lv
 FROM ta.v_event_18 v CROSS JOIN UNNEST(v.friend) AS t
 WHERE v."$part_event"='daily_role_snapshot' AND CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE)=DATE_ADD('day',1,DATE '2026-08-01')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT v.lid,v."#event_time",'技能',TRY_CAST(t.skill_id AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(t.skill_lv AS BIGINT)
 FROM ta.v_event_18 v CROSS JOIN UNNEST(v.skill) AS t(role_id,skill_id,skill_lv)
 WHERE v."$part_event"='daily_role_snapshot' AND CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE)=DATE_ADD('day',1,DATE '2026-08-01')
),
Latest AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY aid,system,item_id ORDER BY et DESC) rn FROM Items),
Q AS (
 SELECT l.*,d."friend.role_id@quality_name" quality
 FROM Latest l LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_53443 d ON TRY_CAST(l.item_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(d."friend.role_id@friend_id" AS INTEGER)
 WHERE l.rn=1 AND l.lv IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT q.aid "账号ID",a.uid "当前映射用户ID",q.system "养成类型",q.item_id "对象ID",q.quality "品质",q.lv "等级",
       COALESCE(b.tags,'') "当前映射黑名单标签",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccountUsers au WHERE au.aid=q.aid) "账号关联用户ID数",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccountUsers au JOIN Blacklist bx ON au.uid=bx.uid WHERE au.aid=q.aid) "任一关联用户命中黑名单数"
FROM Q q LEFT JOIN AccountMap a ON q.aid=a.aid LEFT JOIN Blacklist b ON a.uid=b.uid
WHERE q.quality IN ('史诗','传奇') OR q.lv>=20
ORDER BY q.lv DESC,q.aid,q.system,q.item_id;
